entries.summary: First live spike (568 gens, 2026-10-20). Showed that no PixelLab route leaves the base untouched over an animation: masked inpaint is pixel-exact outside the mask but changes the design per frame, while batch edits (edit-animation-v2, transfer-outfit-v2) keep one design but drift every body pixel. Recommended batch edit plus slot-masked diff extraction, a clothed base and template animations. Its extraction and base recommendations are superseded by S2 (chroma key) and S3/S4 (skeleton-v3, bare base), and template mode is now banned, but its provider measurements (drift, quantization, frame caps, nondeterminism, state not pixel-aligned) still underpin current choices.
